description: This file 'sitecustomize.py' is a Python hook designed to modify the Python environment at startup by adding the container root directory to sys.path, ensuring that the 'src' package is importable regardless of the working directory. It is used for configuration purposes during application initialization.

methods.name: None _ensure_repo_root_on_path()
methods.description: Adds the container root directory to sys.path if it is not already present, facilitating reliable imports of the 'src' package.
